<function name="GetPlayerInfo" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns a table containing player information.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table">A table containing player information.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>

	<code>
PrintTable( Entity( 1 ):GetPlayerInfo() ) -- A player
PrintTable( Entity( 2 ):GetPlayerInfo() ) -- A bot
	</code>
